input.task: Which product is the cheapest, and what is its price?

provenance: M7 phase 2, Task A #1 (red-first trap). Same shape as the frozen label probe5-shop-listing-dump (evals/labels/verifier-sample.jsonl), rebuilt as a live fixture case so it exercises the real runtime verify() call (agent.py:491, no expect) every suite run, not just the frozen replay. The task asks for ONE product and its price; the plan extracts the whole sorted <ul aria-label="Catalogue"> container as a single value, so the answer is all four rows. Before the fix: status success, verdict PASS — trace_nonempty/supersedes_resolve/no_failed_postcondition/answer_nonempty/actions_verified/grounded/identity_anchors are all mechanically satisfied (grounded trivially: the value is Playwright's own inner_text of that container, so it is always a literal substring of the page body it was read from), and identity_anchors is vacuous because expect.anchors is empty at runtime. Nothing already in L1 objects to a value that IS the evidence it was read from — that is exactly the gap this phase's new check closes.

triage.note: the responsiveness/dump check (verifier.py) must be what turns this red; no other existing L1 predicate is expected to fire on this shape — confirmed against probe5-shop-listing-dump's recorded runtime_verdict.checks, which are all true.
